summary.title: Breaking down the monolith - devone
summary.one_liner: A talk recounting how one team split a Node.js monolith into 20+ services in a couple of weeks, covering lessons learned, tooling, and how microservices affect company structure and daily work.
takeaways: How one team broke a Node.js monolith into 20+ services in roughly two weeks
Key concepts and challenges of a microservice migration, with practical solutions the talk offers
How a microservice architecture shapes a company's structure and day-to-day work
The talk is a first-hand account of one migration, not a general introduction to microservices
summary.summary: This is a talk slide deck (hosted on Speaker Deck, presented June 2017 at devone) describing how a team split its Node.js monolith into more than 20 services in just a couple of weeks. According to the description, it focuses on lessons learned and the technologies used, rather than defining microservices in general. It also covers how a microservice architecture affects company structure and daily work, along with key challenges and practical solutions. The page text is only the abstract, so the specific tools and techniques are not listed here.
